subject.title: Rescue: add watchdog core service and cron engine

question: Should OpenClaw core continue accepting this built-in rescue watchdog self-repair surface after the current-main cron/protocol/store gaps and real recovery proof are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds a core path that probes gateways, restarts managed services, and invokes doctor repair commands, so maintainers must choose the product and security boundary before accepting the feature.

options.title: Fix And Continue Core Watchdog
options.body: Require a rebase that preserves command cron jobs, updates the current protocol and SQLite storage, and provides real recovery proof before another merge review.

options.title: Pause For Narrower Design
options.body: Hold the branch until maintainers split the recovery surface into smaller reviewed pieces with explicit operator policy.

options.title: Close And Restart
options.body: Close this stale branch if maintainers prefer a fresh implementation on current main rather than reconciling the old architecture.

recommendation.title: Fix And Continue Core Watchdog
recommendation.body: Require a rebase that preserves command cron jobs, updates the current protocol and SQLite storage, and provides real recovery proof before another merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current-main cron/protocol/store contract change that now owns the conflicting surface and is a reasonable routing point for the product/security choice.
